title: Digital Edge
bottom_line: Digital Edge Indonesia (PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang) is 99.83% owned by Indonet, 92.10% of which belongs to Digital Edge's two Hong Kong companies, now taking it private at Rp11,500 a share; Indonet's 2025 annual report traces control up to Stonepeak entities that co-founder Michael Dorrell controls 100%. The 500 MW CGK campus sits in separate Indonet project companies, which bought Rp741.5 bn of GIIC land from Puradelta Lestari (Sinar Mas Land and Sojitz) and borrowed US$665 m from eight banks led by BCA, Credit Agricole and DBS, plus US$530.2 m from eleven lenders in September 2026. Its power comes only from PLN (2 x 725 MVA on redundant feeds, through the new 350 MVA GI Sukamahi substation); no CGK tenant is named anywhere, CoreWeave included, and the only named builder is a Total Bangun Persada and Accesstech joint operation on a "GAIA" project, which we match to CGK.

entities.name: Digital Edge Indonesia
entities.what: Digital Edge's Indonesian data-centre operator, set up in 2018 and branded EDGE DC until December 2025. It owns and runs EDGE1 (6 MW) and EDGE2 (23 MW) in South Jakarta and fronts the 500 MW CGK Campus. Owned 99.83% by Indonet and 0.17% by Digital Edge (Hong Kong).

entities.name: Digital Edge (group)
entities.what: Singapore-based Asia-Pacific data-centre platform set up in 2020 by Stonepeak and former Equinix, Facebook, Tata Communications and Macquarie executives. Says it has 1.8 GW of secured IT power in nine countries (May 2026). Top operating company above the two Hong Kong holding firms that own Indonet.

entities.name: Digital Edge (Hong Kong)
entities.what: Investment holding company registered in Hong Kong on 24 July 2019, 100% owned by Digital Edge (Singapore) Holdings. Holds 59.10% of Indonet directly and made the 2026 go-private tender offer. Directors: Jonathan Walbridge and John Yung.

entities.name: Digital Edge (HK) SPVI
entities.what: Wholly owned by Digital Edge (Hong Kong). Bought the Indonet founders' 33.0% on 15 December 2023.

entities.name: DEA TopCo LP
entities.what: Cayman limited partnership that is the sole shareholder of Digital Edge (Singapore) Holdings. Its general partner is Stonepeak DEA Cayman GP LLC. The limited partners and their economic shares are not disclosed.

entities.name: Stonepeak DEA Cayman GP
entities.what: General partner (100% control) of DEA TopCo LP.

entities.name: Stonepeak DEA Holdings (UK)
entities.what: Managing member (100% control) of Stonepeak DEA Cayman GP LLC; controlled by Michael Dorrell through intermediate holding companies.

entities.name: Stonepeak
entities.what: US alternative investment firm (infrastructure and real assets). Made the founding investment in Digital Edge in 2020 (US$1 bn equity commitment with its investors and management); its credit arm co-arranged Digital Edge's US$575 m HoldCo loan in May 2026.

entities.name: Indonet
entities.what: Indonesia's first commercial ISP (1994), listed on IDX in February 2021 (ticker EDGE). Fiber and connectivity business and holding company for Digital Edge Indonesia and the DGE project companies. 92.10% Digital Edge and 7.90% public at 30 June 2026; going private through a Rp11,500-a-share tender offer (June to September 2026), with trading suspended since 10 February 2026.

entities.name: DGE1 (Digital Gayana Ekagrata)
entities.what: Indonet project company since 2025, 99.99% Indonet (the rest EDG). Borrower of the US$665 m green loan (March 2026) that Digital Edge says funds CGK phase one, and buyer of Rp741.5 bn of Kota Deltamas land in Q1 2026. Total assets Rp5.40 tn at 30 June 2026.

entities.name: DGE2 (Digital Gayana Ekaprana)
entities.what: Second Indonet project company since 2025, 99.99% Indonet. Co-signed the GAIA 1 supply contracts and borrowed a US$530.2 m facility on 2 September 2026 for its data-centre project (not named). Total assets Rp1.17 tn at 30 June 2026.

entities.name: DGE3 (Digital Gayana Ekatama)
entities.what: Third project company (2026). Indonet injected Rp25 bn in July 2026 and Rp16 bn on 13 October 2026 for capital expenditure; its project is not described.

entities.name: Net Soft
entities.what: Indonet subsidiary (99.52%) in trading and IT services; parent of Fast Speed Network.

entities.name: Fast Speed Network
entities.what: Singapore bandwidth and telecom unit, 100% owned through Net Soft since 2015.

entities.name: Wiratapura Indo Parahyangan
entities.what: Bandung IT-services company, 60% owned by Indonet.

entities.name: EDGE DC (former brand)
entities.what: Name PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang traded under from 2018 until it became Digital Edge Indonesia on 9 December 2025.

entities.name: EPIX
entities.what: Edge Peering Internet Exchange, a carrier-neutral internet exchange at EDGE1 and EDGE2; Indonet says it reached 1.2 Tbps of traffic in 2025, and the operator lists 100+ peering members.

entities.name: EDGE1
entities.what: Jl. Kuningan Barat Raya, Mampang Prapatan, South Jakarta. Operating: 6 MW IT, 1,200-1,300 racks on 5 data-hall floors, launched October 2021 and fully contracted within two years. PLN 18 MVA premium supply, 100% PLN renewable certificates. 92 networks listed in PeeringDB.

entities.name: EDGE2
entities.what: Jl. Kuningan Mulia, Setiabudi, South Jakarta. Operating: 23 MW IT, 3,400+ racks over 15 floors. Construction from September 2022, topped out August 2023, open 28 February 2024, Phase III works to June 2026. PUE 1.24, Nortek StatePoint liquid cooling, LEED Gold (October 2025), PLN 40 MVA premium supply.

entities.name: CGK Campus (GIIC, Cikarang)
entities.what: GIIC estate, Kota Deltamas, Central Cikarang, on up to 25 ha. Under construction: 500 MW IT planned across four buildings (scalable to 1 GW), US$4.5 bn. First building CGK1 topped out June 2026 for service in Q4 2026; buildings two and three due Q1 and Q2 2027. PLN 2 x 725 MVA; 150 kV GI Sukamahi (350 MVA) energised 15 June 2026. Target PUE 1.25, direct-to-chip liquid cooling; spec sheet lists VESDA and Novec fire systems. Indonet's accounts call the project companies' data centre "GAIA 1" (our match to CGK phase one).

entities.name: Indonet DCs (Cyber Building, Rempoa)
entities.what: Indonet's own small data centres: floor 8 of the Cyber Building (Jakarta) and Rempoa (South Tangerang). Capacity not published; operating.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State power utility. Supplies all three Digital Edge sites with premium dual-source service and sold EDG renewable energy certificates.

entities.name: GI 150 kV Sukamahi
entities.what: PLN 150 kV substation, 350 MVA, energised by PLN UIP JBT on 15 June 2026 toward the customer "KTT 5 Digital Edge 1" (the CGK campus). Builder not named.

entities.name: Peak Energy
entities.what: Stonepeak-backed renewable developer and power producer in Asia; June 2024 pact to pursue 500 MW of renewable capacity for Digital Edge sites, Indonesia included. No Indonesian project named yet.

entities.name: Total Bangun Persada
entities.what: Listed Indonesian building contractor. Built EDGE2 Phase III for EDG and holds 50% of the joint operation building the "GAIA Project in Cikarang".

entities.name: Accesstech Engineering
entities.what: Singapore contractor for high-tech and data-centre construction and prefabricated MEP; Jakarta office (PT Accesstech Super Jaya). 50% partner in the GAIA joint operation.

entities.name: KSO Total-Accesstech (GAIA)
entities.what: 50:50 joint operation formed 25 November 2025; won the "GAIA Project in Cikarang" by letter of award dated 5 December 2025. Total's stake was carried at Rp28.45 bn on 30 June 2026.

entities.name: Nortek (StatePoint)
entities.what: Maker of the StatePoint liquid cooling system specified for EDGE2.

entities.name: Furutec (EITA)
entities.what: Furutec is the busduct brand of Malaysia's EITA Resources; it supplied busducts to "Digital Edge's Jakarta facility" in 2024 (building not named).

entities.name: Juniper Networks
entities.what: US network vendor; Indonet runs its newest data-centre network on Juniper QFX switches and Apstra software (November 2022).

entities.name: DCI Indonesia
entities.what: Listed Indonesian data-centre operator founded in 2012 by Otto Toto Sugiri, its President Director since 2016. EDGE1 adopted DCI's design and operating platform (2021), and Indonet bought data-centre and connectivity services from DCI while both were under Sugiri's control.

entities.name: Puradelta Lestari (Kota Deltamas)
entities.what: Sinar Mas Land and Sojitz joint venture that develops Kota Deltamas and the GIIC industrial estate. Sold Rp741.5 bn of land to DGE1 in Q1 2026, 71% of its sales that quarter.
